description: Daisy, a two-player dice race (one die; roll or bank; a 1 loses the turn) played with web tiles at thunderbird.cafe/webtiles/daisy/. The dice are commit-reveal: anyone can re-check a match from its record.

main.description: One player's copy of a finished Daisy match. Each player saves their own; the record key is the match id (a TID made when the commitments are exchanged, just before the coin), so the two copies share it. A player against the bot saves alone.

matchId.description: The match id, also this record's key (a TID).

house.description: The house tile that refereed the match, as pinned by both players' pages.

seat.description: Which player saved this record (1 or 2, an index into players).

target.description: The score that wins, a house setting agreed before the coin.

firstPlayer.description: Who the coin (roll 0) chose to start.

commitments.description: Each player's commitment, in player order: the top of a SHA-256 hash chain made from a secret seed before the coin.

lastReveals.description: The last link each player revealed on that chain, in player order. Hashing forward from it rebuilds every earlier reveal up to the commitment, so the coin and every roll can be recomputed.

rechains.description: Only when a chain ran out: the fresh chains that followed, in order.

forfeitReason.description: Only for a forfeit: the loser let the turn timer run out, was away too long, or didn't reveal their link for a roll.

handle.description: The handle at the time of the match, for display; the did is what counts.

bot.description: True when this seat was played by the table's bot.

rolls.description: Every roll of the turn, in order.

end.description: bank: the turn's points were kept; bust: a 1 lost them; win: the target was reached; forfeit: the match ended here by forfeit.

fromRoll.description: The first roll this chain was used for (the coin is roll 0).

link.description: A SHA-256 hash, as 64 lower-case hex characters.
